title: Pump-02 Low Flow Cavitation & Suction Recovery Procedure

reference_limits.nominal_baseline: Flow 75-90 L/min, Pressure 4.2-5.2 bar, Current 7.5-8.2 A

steps: Acknowledge abnormal flow deviation on Pump-02 supervisory display.
Verify that discharge valve VLV-04-POS is fully open to rule out downstream throttling restriction.
Observe discharge pressure PIT-02-PRS fluctuation and flow rate FIT-02-FLW dropping below 55 L/min.
Check upstream buffer tank TNK-01-LVL to verify adequate suction head (NPSHa > NPSHr).
Reduce pump speed by 15% or throttle suction booster valve to collapse vapor cavitation pockets.
Inspect pump volute and impeller for cavitation pitting noise; restore normal flow above 75 L/min.
